market_summary.trend: BTC ~$65,300 as of Aug 8 afternoon UTC. Up ~0.8% in 24h. 24h range $64,100-$65,300. Bounced from weak July jobs report (-23K vs +80K expected). Testing $65,000-$65,350 resistance zone. Weekend thin liquidity.
market_summary.sentiment: Extreme Fear (F&G ~25 as of Aug 4). NFP-driven bounce (+~1.3%) partially priced in. Short sellers ~$148M facing ongoing liquidation risk. ETF inflows structurally supportive (Goldman Sachs ETF filing). Whale accumulation ($1.2B since Jul 29). Overall cautious but improving.
market_summary.macro: No FOMC in August. Next Fed decision: Sep 15-16 2026. Rate at 3.50%-3.75% (held Jul 29, most divided vote since 2016). Jul NFP badly missed (-23K vs +80K expected), unemployment 4.1%. Fed pause probability for Sep ~56%. CPI Jul: Aug 12 (next key event). FOMC minutes: Aug 19. Jackson Hole late August.
market_summary.catalysts_positive: Weak NFP raises Fed rate-cut hopes. ETF inflows robust ($754M/week, IBIT leading). Goldman Sachs Bitcoin ETF SEC filing. Whale accumulation ongoing. Oil prices lower reducing stagflation risk. BTC dominance 56.6% stable.
market_summary.catalysts_negative: F&G index ~25 (Extreme Fear). $65,000 resistance holding. BTC 48% below Oct 2025 ATH ($126,080). Digital Asset CLARITY Act stalled in Senate (delayed). Weekend illiquidity. August historically worst month for BTC seasonality.
